column1: # ui field batch 3: GuiAssets' private members plus the dialog/hint widgets (38 fields).
# GuiAssets: the fields were already carrying their semantic names when the accessors were named, so
#   this pass only aligns the declarations with them - dialogContentInsets (i, the four insets
#   (D). Its other CheckboxStyle (o) has no accessor and is never read - it stays unnamed.
# TutorialHintBox: stepPlayer (a, the StepSequencePlayer every notifyStepEvent feeds), nextListener
#   pointerImage (g), and the pointer bob state: pointerBaseY (h, the anchor Y), pointerBobOffset (i,
#   integrated by delta*6e-8 and clamped to [-10,0]), bobbingUp (j, flipped at the clamp) and
#   lastFrameTime (k, the nanoTime base of that integration).
# NextClickListener/TutorialListener: the single field is the hint box they were constructed with.
# LoadingProgressDialog: messageLabel (a, what setMessage writes), the ten progressSegments (b), the
#   networkMode flag (c, the constructor boolean that switches the dialog's frame) and
#   lastUpdateTime (d, the throttle for the progress redraw).
# MessageDialog: titleLabel (a) with its 2px offset titleShadowLabel (b), scrollPane (c) whose
#   content is textLabel (d), and buttons (e, the button list setLines rebuilds).
# OkDialog is the same layout without the buttons, so its four fields take the same names.
